seed_world_description: Oink! Oink! Oink! Master, I'm so glad to see you! In general, I like my pen! It's better than the old one. There's plenty of room! And enough dirt! A little more sunshine if only!...
seed_family_description: ...I don't even remember my mother. It seems like another owner took my sister. I wonder how she is? She's probably as pretty as me! Oink! Oink!
seed_occupation_description: You're not going to kill me, are you?! I'm a good girl, after all! I'm a little fat, but I can warm you up if anything! By the way, aren't you cold?! And I miss my boar... Maybe you'll have some fun with me while he's gone? I'm ready! Oink! Oink!..
